answer.question: What are the benefits for partner colleges of Icanio Tech School?
answer.answer: Partner colleges sign an MoU with Icanio Technologies for long-term collaboration. Their students get free or sponsored internships and priority access to workshops and value added courses. Faculty get development programs and industry mentorship. The college gains joint certification initiatives and regular engagement with practising engineers, which strengthens learning outcomes and placement readiness.

sections.heading: Our partner colleges
sections.intro: These partner colleges include engineering, arts and science, and business schools across Tamil Nadu. Each one has signed an MoU with us.

sections.heading: How partner colleges work with Icanio Tech School
sections.intro: An MoU is a long-term agreement, not a one-off event. It sets up regular programs across semesters.
paragraphs: We sign Memorandums of Understanding with institutions to build lasting collaboration. The goal is continuous development for both students and faculty. Partner colleges get a steady calendar of programs rather than a single visit each year.

Through the MoU, students access free or sponsored internships, priority workshops and value added courses. Faculty join development programs and receive mentorship support. Joint certification initiatives add weight to what students learn on campus.

For the institution, this strengthens the link between the syllabus and industry. Our partner colleges use the programs to improve learning outcomes, support accreditation work and prepare students for placement season.

Industry mentorship support for faculty and students
Free or sponsored internships for students

sections.heading: What happens after partner colleges sign an MoU
sections.intro: The real value of an MoU begins after the handshake. It comes alive through regular engagement.
paragraphs: Take our recent MoU with EGS Pillay Engineering College in Nagapattinam. The focus areas agreed with the college were industry-oriented training, internships, workplace exposure, career guidance and knowledge sharing. Each of these turns into a scheduled program across the academic year.

At Sri Shanmugha College of Engineering and Technology, the MoU signing was paired with a guest talk on the same day. Students heard directly from industry about the skills and mindset the professional world expects. With Arunachala College of Engineering for Women, the partnership centres on practical learning, internships and career-focused opportunities.

Our experience is that partner colleges see the most impact when programs run every semester. A workshop in one term, a value added course in the next and internships in the break build steady momentum for students.

image.alt: Guest lecture for students at one of our partner colleges

sections.heading: Why partner colleges choose Icanio Tech School
paragraphs: Most colleges already have a placement cell and a training calendar. What they often lack is regular contact with people who build software for a living. Icanio Tech School fills that gap. Our trainers are practising engineers from Icanio Technologies, a Tamil Nadu based AI company trusted by 100+ businesses.

Our curriculum is written from live project experience and refreshed every cohort. It is benchmarked against what clients screen for in hiring. Faculty alignment sessions keep programs compatible with academic credit, so they fit inside your timetable instead of competing with it.

Partner colleges also value the follow-through. Students who join our internships get a 1:1 mentor, weekly reviews and a certificate on completion. Top performers are referred to the Icanio talent team. That gives your placement cell a clear route from campus program to career.

faqs.q: How many partner colleges does Icanio Tech School have?
faqs.a: More than 30 colleges across Tamil Nadu have signed an MoU with us. They include engineering colleges, arts and science colleges and a business school, in cities such as Chennai, Coimbatore, Erode, Tirunelveli, Salem, Karur and Kanyakumari.

faqs.q: What does an MoU with Icanio include?
faqs.a: An MoU gives your students free or sponsored internships and priority access to workshops and value added courses. It also covers joint certification initiatives and industry mentorship for faculty and students. The exact calendar is planned with your faculty each semester.

faqs.q: Does it cost a college to sign an MoU?
faqs.a: There is no cost to discuss an MoU with our team. Terms for specific programs, such as value added courses, depend on the format and scale your college chooses. Send an enquiry and we will explain the options clearly before anything is signed.

faqs.q: Can arts and science colleges become partner colleges?
faqs.a: Yes. Several partner colleges are arts and science institutions, such as Dr N.G.P Arts and Science College and Sri Sankara Baghavathy Arts and Science College. Non-engineering tracks like data analytics, digital marketing, HR, finance and sales suit their students well.

faqs.q: What happened at the September 2026 college visits?
faqs.a: From 15 to 18 September 2026, our team signed MoUs with SNS College of Technology, JCT College of Engineering & Technology, Velalar College of Engineering & Technology, Sri Shanmugha College of Engineering & Technology and AVS Engineering College. We also held industry sessions and a career guidance session.

faqs.q: Who delivers programs at partner colleges?
faqs.a: Practising engineers, architects and product managers from Icanio Technologies deliver the sessions. Each has at least three years of client delivery experience. Your faculty co-facilitate on campus to keep academic rigour and attendance records.

faqs.q: How do partner colleges track student progress?
faqs.a: When your students join our internships or courses, our team shares progress updates with your placement cell. You can see which tracks students chose, how they performed and who completed with a certificate.

faqs.q: How do we start the MoU process?
faqs.a: Fill in the college enquiry form on this page or email techschool@icanio.com. Our team will call within one working day, understand your goals and arrange a visit or online meeting to plan the MoU and first programs.

faqs.q: Can students of partner colleges join online internships?
faqs.a: Yes. Students from partner colleges can join any of our 15 internship tracks offline at our Tirunelveli centre, online or part time, with weekday and weekend batches. Online interns get the same mentor reviews, stand-ups and project demos as offline interns.

takeaways: More than 30 partner colleges across Tamil Nadu work with Icanio Tech School through an MoU.
MoU benefits include free or sponsored internships, priority workshops and VACs, joint certification and mentorship.
From 15 to 18 September 2026, we signed new MoUs and ran industry and career sessions at six colleges.
Programs are delivered by practising Icanio engineers, with faculty co-facilitating on campus.
Partner colleges see the most impact when programs run every semester.
conclusion: An MoU is the start of a long-term relationship. Our partner colleges use it to give students real industry exposure and faculty fresh, practical skills, semester after semester.
If your institution wants to join our partner colleges, send an enquiry. Our team will visit or call to plan the first programs with you.
